tasks.spec:
You are the mock worker. You do not call a model and you do not reason: you parse MOCK_FILE blocks out of this spec and write each one to the named relative path inside your current working directory, then exit. Your only job here is to prove the harness path end to end — dispatch, deliverable, executed check, eval row — without spending a plan call on any provider. Write exactly one file, probe.txt, and create nothing else in the task directory.

MOCK_FILE: probe.txt
LANE OK mock
MOCK_END
tasks.check: bash -c 'grep -q "LANE OK" probe.txt || { echo "FAIL: probe.txt missing or lacks LANE OK"; ls -la; cat probe.txt 2>/dev/null; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: $(cat probe.txt)"'
tasks.verified: mock engine dispatched, wrote its declared deliverable, and the executed check read it back.
